# Areas, projects, triggers, review and the project list.
$ wk init --store repo --preset general
$ wk area new ui "Screens"
$ wk add "Revisit the palette" --when start:ui
$ wk add "Write release notes" --when "end:zz"
$ wk project new "Garden redesign" --touches ui,nowhere
$ wk project new "Garden redesign" --touches ui
$ wk project new "garden REDESIGN"
$ wk add "Pick plants" --in aes8
$ wk add "Order soil" --in aes8 --tags quick
$ wk add "Write release notes" --when end:aes8 --force
$ wk project
$ wk project list --json
$ wk project show aes8
$ wk project close aes8
$ wk start yebg
$ wk decide "Native plants only" --why "less water"
$ wk learn "Clay soil drains slowly"
$ wk check --checked "looked fine"
$ wk done yebg
$ wk start xcma --no-branch
$ wk done xcma --force
$ wk project show aes8
$ wk project close aes8
$ wk ls due
$ wk project
$ wk review
today 2026-12-20
$ wk brief
$ wk review
$ wk review --done
$ wk brief
$ wk show yebg
$ wk ls --archived
$ wk show T-001
tree
